title: AgentRuntime
description: Declarative runtime descriptor for a TraceMind agent. Phase 5 shipped only kind=inprocess; Phase 6 Stage 6-2 introduced the remote kind for cross-process / cross-host agents driven by tm.transport. Additive — existing kind=inprocess YAMLs continue to validate without modification.

kind.description: Runtime implementation selector. Phase 5 builtins include tm-shell, tm-noop, tm-http-mock. Phase 6 adds inprocess (alias/default) and remote (cross-node via Transport).

endpoint.description: URL or peer identifier for kind=remote runtimes (e.g. https://leaf-1:8080).

transport_kind.description: Transport implementation selected by the resolver when kind=remote.

auth_ref.description: Opaque secret-store reference; never inline a token here.
